title: Demo Exit State
description: Schema for demo-state.json produced by the /run-exit-demo skill. Captures the structured outcome of a Forgekeeper exit-demo run (Playwright reporter path, passed/failing specs, auto-recovery actions, blocker context, and harness staleness fields). See plan-run-exit-demo.md §D-7.

harness_head_sha.description: Forgekeeper repo HEAD SHA at the moment the skill ran. Used by the runner for staleness detection (see D-10).

harness_worktree_dirty.description: True if `git status --porcelain` was non-empty at run time. The runner treats dirty=true as a staleness warning regardless of SHA match.

json_summary.description: Verbatim D-9 summary from dev/demo-e2e/src/main.ts stdout last line.

playwright_reporter_path.description: Path to the Playwright JSON reporter output (typically dev/demo-e2e/test-results/results.json) captured during this run. Carried by reference, not inlined. NULL when Playwright did not run (e.g. preflight failed before spawning — see dev/demo-e2e/src/main.ts:163 path).

spec_id.description: The Playwright test title (codebase-analysis.md §2 — spec identifier IS the test title).

reporter_error.description: Optional short excerpt of the Playwright reporter's error message field for this spec. By reference only — full traces stay in run_logs.

fingerprint_before_path.description: For known_hosts recovery, path inside the run-logs archive that captured the prior host fingerprint (by reference).
